policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Southwest Baptist's seventeen goals exceed the combined total of Lincoln, McKendree, Missouri-St. Louis, Indianapolis, Illinois Springfield, Upper Iowa and William Jewell; the shape is still one side and a field, and the first side to hold them, Missouri-St. Louis, is on that list.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Missouri-St. Louis are the first side to score against Southwest Baptist this season, and they did it twice.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Three matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, and Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan. No final is missing its score.

claims.text: Quincy have scored nine goals and conceded four, and Leo Cann has four of the nine from nineteen shots; the win at McKendree was their first away from home this season.

claims.text: McKendree have won one and lost three, scoring three and conceding five; the win came at Cedarville, and their first home match of the season was lost to Quincy.
